facts.claim: Canaves Collection (Oia) Weddings page: 'Panorama Balcony – Canaves Oia Suites ... up to 30 guests can gather as the stunning Caldera and the endless Aegean set the scene for an impeccable wedding ceremony.' CALDERA WORDING: 'the stunning Caldera and the endless Aegean set the scene'.

Canaves Collection Weddings page: 'Veranda – Canaves Sunday': 'an unforgettable wedding for up to 40 guests atop our majestic rooftop venue, with 180-degree panoramic views of the caldera'. CALDERA WORDING: '180-degree panoramic views of the caldera'.

Canaves Collection Weddings page: 'Sunset Terrace – Canaves Epitome' is 'a luxury space for weddings with up to 25 guests'. Canaves Epitome's own weddings page says 'the fascinating views of the Aegean sea and the caldera set up the most romantic setting to say the anticipated "I do"'; it names the Sunset Terrace for the ceremony and the Sunset Pool Lounge for 'cocktail and dinner reception'.
facts.conflicts: Weddings page: Sunset Terrace up to 25 guests; Exclusives & Buyouts table: theatre 100 / banquet 80 / reception 100 (fact_06).

facts.claim: Canaves Collection wedding enquiry form lists ceremony types Religious, Civil, Symbolic and Vow Renewal; the page says it caters 'from traditional weddings to modern elopements' and links a wedding brochure with package options (no amounts recorded).

Canaves Collection Exclusives & Buyouts page lists full-property buyouts: Canaves Epitome 53 rooms, max 170 guests; Canaves Ena 18 rooms, max 45; Canaves Oia Suites 48 rooms, max 120; Canaves Sunday 10 rooms, max 22. 'With a full property buyout, every space becomes part of your story.' Canaves Epitome is described as 'ideal for full property buyouts'.

Canaves Exclusives & Buyouts venue table: Canaves Epitome Outdoor Gardens theatre 180 / banquet 250 / reception 280; Sunset Terrace theatre 100 / banquet 80 / reception 100; Canaves Sunday Veranda theatre 40 / banquet 40 / reception 60; Canaves Oia Suites Panorama 30 / 30 / 30.

Mystique (Oia) home page: 'Carved into the rugged Caldera cliffs, Mystique, a Luxury Collection Hotel, overlooks the midnight blue waters of the Aegean Sea'. CALDERA WORDING: 'Carved into the rugged Caldera cliffs'.

Mystique 'Marry me in Santorini' Weddings page: 'Our wedding specialists will take care of every aspect'; 'Our alluring venues serve as an idyllic backdrop for the ceremony of your dreams ... Share your vision with us and we'll find the perfect setting'; couples can get ready 'in one of our stunning suites with infinite views of the Aegean Sea'; Elios Spa offers treatments. Capacity, ceremony types and exclusive use not published on the page.

Katikies Santorini (Oia) hotel page meta description: 'A 5-star private escape with those stunning Caldera views'. Gea House 'offers sweeping, unobstructed views of the Caldera and the volcano'; Pelagos House is 'Suspended on the dramatic cliffs right in the vibrant heart of Oia'. CALDERA WORDING: 'stunning Caldera views' and 'unobstructed views of the Caldera and the volcano'.

Katikies Events page (Santorini venues): Botrini's Restaurant at Katikies Santorini, seated 60 / standing 100, 'Ideal for wedding ceremonies; lunches, dinners and standing cocktail receptions'; Katikies Lounge Lower Deck at Katikies Santorini, seated 50 / standing 100, 'Ideal for lunches, dinners, standing cocktail receptions'. The Events enquiry form lists 'Weddings' and 'Hotel Take over'.

Katikies Events page: 'Our events and concierge team will carefully plan and manage every detail of your wedding'; package idea 'Micro weddings' in Santorini or Mykonos, 'small, exclusive ceremonies ... set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Aegean Sea'.

Katikies Santorini FAQ: children above 13 years old are welcome (younger children are pointed to Katikies Garden in Fira); check-in from 3:00 pm, check-out until 11:00 am; private transfer service up to 4 people.

Andronis Weddings & Celebrations page: 'Picture yourselves exchanging vows against the awe-inspiring caldera, as the sun dips into the horizon'; enquiry form event types Wedding, Birthday, Anniversary, Dining Event; a wedding brochure is linked. The page does not name which Andronis property hosts ceremonies, and notes it contains 'materials generated using AI'. CALDERA WORDING: 'exchanging vows against the awe-inspiring caldera'.

Andronis Luxury Suites (Oia): '39 acclaimed suites and villas ... Perched atop cliffs, they offer mesmerizing views of the Aegean Sea against the volcanic caldera'; home to Lycabettus Restaurant (described as Greece's only 2-MICHELIN Starred) and Mare Sanus Spa. The hotel page menu links to the group Weddings & Celebrations page.

insider_details.detail: Oia's caldera-edge ceremony spaces are intimate (Canaves Panorama Balcony 30, Veranda 40, Sunset Terrace 25 as wedding spaces; Katikies Botrini's 60 seated), so a guest list beyond about 60 points to a buyout of a larger property such as Canaves Epitome (max 170 guests) or a split between ceremony and reception spaces.
Canaves Sunset Terrace is listed for 25 guests as a wedding space but 100 reception in the buyout table: confirm which figure applies to your package before you cap the guest list.
Katikies Santorini only accepts children over 13, so families with young children need Katikies Garden in Fira or another hotel for those guests.
Use separate spaces for each event: Canaves Epitome names a Sunset Terrace for the ceremony and the Sunset Pool Lounge for cocktails and dinner, which keeps the evening moving without a venue change.
